summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of PROSPECTIA. All 32 pytest backend tests pass (auth, dashboard, demo seed, companies CRUD + filter/search/bulk/CSV import & export, contacts, AI analyze+score, AI email generation (with 400 when no analysis), email validate → 3 auto follow-ups, follow-up generation, reply classification → opportunity + follow-ups cancelled, opportunity update, campaigns, templates, services, exclusions, activity, errors, settings, cleanup). Frontend UI verified with Playwright: login, dashboard KPIs + charts, seed demo (10 companies), companies list/search/add-modal, company detail (generate-email correctly disabled when no analysis), validation → email sent (simulation) + 3 follow-ups created, replies page, all 13 sidebar routes load without errors, exclusions add button, settings tabs, persistence after reload, logout → /login redirect.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` — accessibility warning in console; add DialogDescription to comply with a11y.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined} removed) to Radix DialogContent components to satisfy accessibility warnings.
OPTIONAL: Remove unused imports in Dashboard.jsx (FunnelChart, Funnel imported but not used).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 900+ lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, companies, emails, ai, followups, replies) for maintainability.
ai_service._extract_json uses a permissive regex; if the LLM ever returns nested braces it may misparse. Consider json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode as a fallback.
get_current_user still reads cookie fallback but the frontend uses Bearer only — code path is dead unless cookie auth is planned.
detect_duplicate query only searches by exact name (line 248); if a different company has same website/phone it won't be detected. Consider $or query.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically inconsistent (browsers reject credentials with wildcard). For production, set explicit origins.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/demo/seed → 10 demo companies + contacts + campaigns + emails + replies + opportunities created. Test data prefixed with TEST_/UI_TEST_ was cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0` (must use -n 0 because tests share module-level STATE across classes; loadscope with -n 2 pins each class to a different worker breaking dependencies). AI operations take ~5-15s each; use timeouts >=60s. Follow-up delays default [3,7,14] days. Reply category 'Intéressé/Souhaite un rendez-vous/Demande d'informations' creates opportunity and cancels pending follow-ups.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All requested features work as specified.
